name: Maids and Magic
source:
»Oh, so you want to be a brave Magical Girl.
An impatient one, too – good lord, what a whirl «

[From [url=https://fiorett.itch.io/maids-and-magic]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“哦，原来你想成为一名勇敢的魔法少女呀。
而且还是个急性子——老天爷，这可真是一场叫人头晕目眩的风波。”

[摘自[url=https://fiorett.itch.io/maids-and-magic]itch.io[/url]]
